children: According to CNBC, Bangkok's governor declared Thailand's capital a disaster-affected zone on Saturday after torrential rain caused widespread flooding, and the weather agency forecast thunderstorms over the weekend. Nearly 300 mm (12 inches) of rain fell within 48 hours, flooding major roads and leaving cars partly submerged as people waded through waist-high water. Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said the crisis poses a risk to people's lives and could damage public and private property, with conditions most severe near canals. The army said it is setting up shelters and field kitchens, while the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration designated schools as temporary accommodation and urged residents to avoid unnecessary travel. The government also issued an emergency advisory for people living near canals to move possessions to higher ground. Suvarnabhumi airport was operating normally, though the tourism authority advised travelers to allow an extra two to three hours in their plans.

title: Bangkok Declares Disaster Zone After Torrential Rain Triggers Widespread Flooding
